objectives: Explain why Joseph planted the cup in Benjamin's sack.
Describe Judah's plea and offer to stand in Benjamin's place.
takeaways: The cup was planted so Joseph could hold Benjamin and draw out the truth about his father.
Jacob never got over Joseph; sorrow hath killed many.
Judah offered to abide instead of the lad as a bondman, for his father's life was bound up in the lad's life.
